items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: Some of them, I noticed Barberant, he doesn't have, yeah, his bass drum, he only had one head

ctx.x: Huh? Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. So you have to be flexible. The last job we played, we played a few rock tunes, you know, and they enjoyed it. But the elderly people, or the middle aged people, they want that right on the beach. There's fellas around Chicago that don't use the bass drum anymore. They don't use it, just the cymbals. Yeah, I hate to work with people like that. Yeah. Some of them, I noticed Barberant, he doesn't have, yeah, his bass drum, he only had one head, and this outside head he doesn't have.
That wasn't his drum, he was playing on the bass drum.
